states.verdict: The two bars are the same bars — same 32/26 px heights, same #4A4A4A number over #8C8C8C label, same Library and View icons to the pixel — so this comes down to two mistakes, and only B makes them. Opening B's empty document, the very first thing your eye lands on is a caret slicing the S of the placeholder in half; that is the one pixel a writer stares at before typing and B got it wrong. states.verdict: B's menu can't hold a left margin: three rows — including the selected one at the very top, the first thing your eye lands on — hang 11 px out into the tick gutter because the panel was sized to nothing in particular.
